name: ExternalService
description: Configuration for an outbound API integration (Stripe, SendGrid, etc.). Stores base URL, OAuth credentials (encrypted), scopes, and auth method. Functions access these via ctx.service('serviceName'). Generic data API is blocked because the row carries credential material; CUD goes through a dedicated service controller.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Unique name per tenant (e.g., trillo-aos-default, hubspot-crm)

attributes.name: tokenEndpoint
attributes.description: Token URL path (e.g., /api/v2.0/auth/token). Blank defaults to /api/v2.0/auth/token

attributes.name: clientId
attributes.description: Client ID issued by the external service

attributes.name: clientSecretEncrypted
attributes.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted client secret. Never stored in plaintext.

attributes.name: scopes
attributes.description: Space-separated scopes to request during token exchange

attributes.name: authMethod
attributes.description: Authentication method: client_credentials, oauth2, api_key, basic

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Human-readable purpose of this service connection
